name: focus-memory
description: Qdrant-based work memory, project facts graph search and automatic context recall for qwen-code

UserPromptSubmit.description: FocusMemory auto context search — retrieves related work history and decisions from Qdrant on every prompt submission

SKILL.state — per-turn state anchor: when the context has grown past the token threshold, inject a compact one-line Σ 'where are we' reminder (no LLM call, millisecond-scale). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

Stop.description: Turn-end guard — block stop when the turn result is a session-summary claiming no active task while a work anchor (Σ state / in-progress todos) exists; re-injects the anchor as the continuation prompt so the model resumes work instead of parking in a 'waiting' state. Self-limits via Σ (max 3 blocks / 30 min window, identical-message loop skip). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

Ghost file citation gate — block stop when the turn's final message cites a dated todos file (todos/YYYY-MM-DD.md, relative or absolute) that does not exist on disk (2026-09-26 confabulation class: a ghost file citation anchored a fabricated work narrative); re-injects a correction prompt forcing disk re-verification. Self-limits via Σ (max 3 blocks / 30 min window, identical-message loop skip). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)
Hard Gate (write-back) — detect completion signal and ask user to record decision via remember_decision

SKILL.state — per-Stop checkpoint: records last_input_tokens every turn and spawns the detached Σ extraction worker when (1) a mutating tool call (edit/write_file/remember_decision) was logged since the last extraction, or (2) the context grew 50k+ past it (prose-only drift fallback). Warm checkpoints: fault tolerance + fresher state before compaction. Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

PreCompact.description: SKILL.state — spawn detached Σ extraction worker from the pre-compaction transcript (runs in parallel with native compaction, never blocks it). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

PostCompact.description: DA dead-marker observation — count [[da:]/<da: marker strings copied into the compaction summary (telemetry only; the hook output channel is a no-op in qwen-code). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_DA=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

SKILL.state — bump Σ.compact_count on every real compaction so the post-compaction anchor window (userprompt-inject-state.js) opens on the first turn after compaction. The SessionStart(source=compact) hook remains a deduped fallback (30s window in bumpCompactCount). Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

SessionStart.description: SKILL.state — re-inject structured execution state (Σ) after compaction so the model prefers explicit state over the prose summary. Gated by FOCUSMEMORY_SKILLSTATE=on (off/unset → immediate no-op, fail-open)

SessionEnd.description: Cleanup — remove this session's per-session state files and sweep stale files (7 days) left by sessions that ended without a SessionEnd event
